name: Docboard
description: The repository's docs in the bottom dock: read, search, ask by meaning, see what is open, and operate the development environment. Person-only; no agent tool.

settings.label: Repository
settings.description: Absolute path to the repository to map. Empty uses the first workspace where Docboard is on.

settings.label: Embedding model (.gguf)
settings.description: Optional; empty discovers the EmbeddingGemma Recall keeps under the PiCode data folder.

settings.label: llama-server binary
settings.description: Optional; empty discovers the pinned llama.cpp release under the PiCode data folder.

settings.label: Operate commands
settings.description: Off hides the Operar view and its fixed make targets in this repository.
